title: Genghis Khan to SpongeBob: how?
description: Five Great Khans, two pages of a medieval Marco Polo manuscript, 82 popes, the Obamas and a London soccer drill connect Genghis Khan to SpongeBob SquarePants.
hook: How's Genghis Khan linked to SpongeBob?

links.line: In 1260, Genghis Khan's grandson, Kublai Khan, became the fifth Great Khan.
In the 1400s, a French book painted Kublai welcoming Venice's Polo brothers.
In 1271, the Polos met Pope Gregory X, painted in the same book.

links.line: In 2013, 82 popes after Gregory, the line reached Pope Francis.

image.file: File:Pope Francis and the Obamas at the White House.jpg

links.line: In 2015, Francis met Barack and Michelle Obama at the White House.
And in 2012, in London, Michelle kicked a goal past SpongeBob.
